about: Phase 2 additions to the intelligence evaluation set (v1 stays untouched). Same row format and label meaning as v1 (see intelligence-eval-v1.json 'about'). One optional field: down = skill groups that are unavailable for this row (the model-mode run marks their cards available:false, so the honest card decline is tested; the rule-only run ignores it). Labels say what the RIGHT behaviour is, written from the request, not from what the code does. Not tuned on: do not edit rows to make a phase pass.
